name: Jedit Ojanen
description: Magically transported through time to defeat Ur-Drago.

timeline.summary: Jedit Ojanen leaves his tribe, joins the Robaran Mercenaries and rises to lead them in the battle for Efrava.
timeline.quote: Jedit Ojanen forsook the forests of his tribe and took service with the Robaran Mercenaries, rising through their ranks to lead them in the battle for Efrava.

citation.text: Jedit Ojanen (Legends, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Battle of Efrava is fought in the air over the oasis between airships, ending Johan's War.
timeline.quote: The war's last battle was the Battle of Efrava, which was fought in the air over the oasis between both sides' flying airships.

citation.text: "Efrava", section "Efrava in the time of Jedit Ojanen". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Adira Strongheart's mercenaries free Johan; Jedit Ojanen knocks Shauku back and the freed Cosmic Horror summons a Falling Star that obliterates the ruin.
timeline.quote: the freed Cosmic Horror summoned a Falling Star to obliterate the entire ruin.

citation.text: "Shauku", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Disguised as a human, Johan reaches Efrava and uses a charm to manipulate Jedit into pleading to be his guardian.
timeline.quote: he used his mental control of Jedit to have him plead to be his guardian.

citation.text: "Johan", section "Johan's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Johan's treachery is discovered; he kills Efravan guards and flees west with Jedit in pursuit.
timeline.quote: Johan killed a couple of Efravan guards to escape to the desert

citation.text: "Johan", section "Johan's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jedit charges Johan and they fall overboard; Johan is eaten by a sand wurm, as Jaeger had been.
timeline.quote: Johan died the same way Jaeger Ojanen had: eaten by a sand wurm .

citation.text: "Johan", section "Johan's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Peace follows Johan's death; Hazezon governs Bryce then vanishes with a skyship fleet, and Jedit leads the reunited tiger tribes to the Scarwood.
timeline.quote: The death of Johan ushered in an era of peace and prosperity in Jamuraa

citation.text: "Johan", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jedit saves Johan from a sand wurm; under Efravan law Johan is imprisoned for execution, but Jedit and Hestia delay it and Johan later escapes.
timeline.quote: Johan escaped, and Jedit followed him

citation.text: "Johan's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Palmyra Johan deceives Jedit and unleashes his bloodlust against Hazezon and Adira; the Robarans reveal Jaeger was their friend and Jedit nearly kills Johan, who escapes with Beasts of Bogardan.
timeline.quote: Johan summoned Beasts of Bogardan to escape.

citation.text: "Johan's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Johan is tricked into an enchantment and imprisoned at Shauku's castle, where she reveals she is a vampire who manipulated him; Adira accidentally frees him and the castle is destroyed by a Falling Star.
timeline.quote: After Adira accidentally freed Johan, the group escaped

citation.text: "Johan's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Johan builds a fleet of airships powered by powerstones to invade Bryce, Efrava and the surrounding regions, while the resistance gathers allies and secures airships of its own.
timeline.quote: Johan sought to expand his dominion by constructing a fleet of airships powered by powerstones.

citation.text: "Johan's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Johan's forces besiege Efrava, and Jedit's coalition wages guerrilla warfare until reinforcements from Bryce and Scarwood arrive.
timeline.quote: The war reached its climax in Efrava

citation.text: "Johan's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the final confrontation Johan slays Adira but is dragged from the sky by Jedit and devoured by a colossal sand wurm, ending the war.
timeline.quote: Johan slew Adira but was ultimately dragged from the sky by Jedit.

citation.text: "Johan's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hazezon resumes ruling Bryce before leaving to explore the world, while Jedit leads the Robarans into a new era of expansion.
timeline.quote: With Johan dead, the Tirrans collapsed into disarray, and the war came to an end.

citation.text: "Johan's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jedit Ojanen is magically transported to the duel's moment and defeats Ur-Drago himself.
timeline.quote: before Jedit Ojanen would be magically transported to this crucial point in time and defeat Ur-Drago himself.

citation.text: "Terrent Amese", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jedit rediscovers the tribes' origins, and the four tribes make peace, return to Scarwood, rebuild the Tabernacle and found an empire.
timeline.quote: The four tribes would end up making peace with one another

citation.text: "Terrent Amese", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Johan, saved by Jedit from a sand wurm, is imprisoned in Efrava; Hestia delays his execution, he escapes and Jedit follows him.
timeline.quote: he manages to free himself and flees the oasis, followed by Jedit

citation.text: "Jedit (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In Palmyra Johan lies that Hazezon and Adira killed Jaeger and sends Jedit, under spells, to attack them; the spells conflict and the Robarans reveal the truth.
timeline.quote: permitting the Robaran Mercenaries to reveal to him that Jaeger was their good friend

citation.text: "Jedit (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jedit sees Jaeger's medallion on Johan and realizes Johan killed his father; Johan escapes by summoning Beasts of Bogardan and receives a vision from Shauku.
timeline.quote: understands that the tyrant killed his father

citation.text: "Jedit (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jedit joins Adira's Circle of Seven; Hazezon shifts them atop the mountains and stays behind.
timeline.quote: Jedit is enlisted in Adira's Circle of Seven

citation.text: "Jedit (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Robarans are cleared of the sage's murder, attacked by Johan's corsairs and shipwrecked, then saved by Beckoner and the Born of the Beck.
timeline.quote: They are saved by Beckoner and the Born of the Beck tribe

citation.text: "Jedit (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Robarans infiltrate Shauku's castle; Adira frees Johan, Jedit incapacitates Shauku, and they escape as the Falling Star destroys the castle.
timeline.quote: After Jedit incapacitates Shauku

citation.text: "Jedit (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The survivors prepare to return home to stop Johan's conquest.
timeline.quote: prepare to return home and stop Johan's plan of conquest

citation.text: "Jedit (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jedit, Hazezon, Adira and the Seveners infiltrate Tirras to assassinate Johan but are captured; Hazezon and Adira are imprisoned, the rest sent to a work camp where Jedit learns of airships.
timeline.quote: they are quickly discovered and captured

citation.text: "Hazezon (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Robarans steal an airship, rouse the slaves, rescue Hazezon and Adira, but Johan's storm throws them off course.
timeline.quote: The Robarans manage to steal a ship, rouse the slaves, and sail through the air toward Tirras.

citation.text: "Hazezon (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The ship is thrown against a Magnetic Mountain, killing many, and the survivors resolve to travel on foot to the sea.
timeline.quote: killing a lot of its passengers

citation.text: "Hazezon (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jedit is visited by a cat ghost and the party helps the half-elves of Scarwood against giant apes.
timeline.quote: Jedit and the others help the elves against the apes

citation.text: "Hazezon (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale Jedit learns the history of the cat warriors and that the ghost was Ojanen's lover; he slays Ur-Drago but is gravely wounded.
timeline.quote: Ur-Drago attacks Jedit and the tiger man manages to slay his foe

citation.text: "Hazezon (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jedit is rescued and taken to Bryce, where the fleet needs powerstones; Adira and Jedit sail for Koltos.
timeline.quote: Adira and Jedit sail towards the island of Koltos

citation.text: "Hazezon (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Koltos a Master of the Hunt heals Jedit and helps defeat DePietro, freeing the fishermen and gaining powerstones.
timeline.quote: the demigod not only cures Jedit of his wounds

citation.text: "Hazezon (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jedit and Adira fly to Efrava, where Jedit's claim to be the first Ojanen is met coldly; he seeks help from other cat tribes and gains the Hooraree and Sulaki.
timeline.quote: he manages to make a tenuous covenant with the Hooraree

citation.text: "Hazezon (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Johan attacks Efrava; Jedit, now general of the Efravans, leads guerrilla warfare and allied reinforcements retake the village, and Adira devises a plan to attack Johan's ship.
timeline.quote: the alliance manages to recapture the village of the Efravans

citation.text: "Hazezon (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Robarans reach Johan's flagship; Adira stabs Johan but is killed by him; Jedit and Johan fall to the desert where a sand wurm eats Johan.
timeline.quote: a sand wurm emerges from the dunes and eats him

citation.text: "Hazezon (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: With Johan dead, Tirras scatters; Jedit becomes chief of the Robarans and Hazezon governor of Bryce before travelling the world.
timeline.quote: decides to become the new chief of the Robarans

citation.text: "Hazezon (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Efrava is destroyed and its cat warriors scatter across Dominaria.
timeline.quote: After Efrava was destroyed, the cat warriors scattered across Dominaria.

citation.text: Jedit's Dragoons (Time Spiral, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: In 3334 AR Adira's party arrives at Buzzard's Bay in search of Johan.
timeline.quote: arrived at Buzzard's Bay in search of Johan

citation.text: "Adventurers' Guildhouse", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A party of Jedit, Adira, Jasmine and the Circle of Seven frees the Cosmic Horror, which summons a Falling Star to annihilate the caverns; Shauku secretly escapes.
timeline.quote: They freed the Cosmic Horror, which summoned another Falling Star to annihilate the caverns

citation.text: "Caverns of Despair", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jedit Ojanen visits the Hooraree in 3336 AR and sees they have outgrown their oasis.
timeline.quote: When Jedit Ojanen visited them in 3336 AR , he realized that the Hooraree had outgrown their oasis

citation.text: "Hooraree", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jedit Ojanen visits the Khyyiani oasis to recruit them against Johan; they vehemently refuse.
timeline.quote: but they vehemently refused

citation.text: "Khyyiani", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jedit Ojanen visits the Dark Heart in 3336 AR, defeats the apes, and kills its guardian Ur-Drago.
timeline.quote: After killing its guardian, Ur-Drago

citation.text: "Scarwood", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jedit convinces the four cat warrior tribes that Terrent Amese was not a god and negotiates safe passage through the Scarwood.
timeline.quote: Jedit was able to negotiate safe passage through the Scarwood for any cat warrior

citation.text: "Scarwood", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Shikka chooses to stay and protect the forest rather than follow Jedit, persuading Talack to stay too.
timeline.quote: She chose to stay, convincing her companion Talack to do the same.

citation.text: "Shikka", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jedit tries to unite the cat warrior tribes against Johan; the Sulaki refuse to ally with non-worshippers of Ergerborg.
timeline.quote: the Sulaki first refused to ally with anyone not worshiping Ergerborg

citation.text: "Sulaki", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jedit uses a skyship to uproot the giant brown stone symbolizing Ergerborg.
timeline.quote: Jedit used the skyship of the Robaran Mercenaries to uproot the giant brown-stone and cast it to the side

citation.text: "Sulaki", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Johan's War, Jedit Ojanen and his cat warrior followers rebuild the tabernacle.
timeline.quote: it was rebuilt by Jedit Ojanen and his cat warrior followers

citation.text: "Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale", section "Scarwood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jedit Ojanen, magically transported to that moment, defeats Ur-Drago.
timeline.quote: Jedit Ojanen was magically transported to this crucial point in time and defeated Ur-Drago himself

citation.text: "Ur-Drago", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
